summary: LEGION-25 Part B (legion controller start, the operator-launched controller for runtime: kubernetes) on pull request #1110, reviewed at head e82da69112b42591365b11011700c923e5adbb43 (code head 58785d9a; identical code). Verdict REQUEST_CHANGES on two correctness findings, both small: (1) the kind overlay's legion.yaml (deploy/kubernetes/daemon/overlays/kind/legion.yaml, which replaces the base ConfigMap key wholesale) lacks the now-mandatory operator_token_file, so the in-cluster daemon it ships refuses to boot — confirmed by loading the overlay through loadConfigFromFile + resolveDaemonConfig({resolveSecrets:false}): it throws `operator_token_file is required when runtime is kubernetes`, the base resolves; the kind walkthrough's shell block in docs/kubernetes.md also omits `cp secrets/operator.env.example secrets/operator.env`, without which kubectl apply -k refuses to build (spec Acceptance 1 broken); (2) legion controller start fetches the controller secret (the daemon revokes the incumbent controller's secret and grants) before resolving the prompt directory, statting controller-root.md, reading the instructions file, and writing the state directory, so a laptop-only misconfiguration — a release binary without LEGION_ROLE_PROMPTS_DIR, the case the runbook warns about — kills the running controller's credentials and launches nothing. Every other constraint the spec and plan named holds (ProcessManager reads no locator shape; runtime-kubernetes.ts additive and k8s-manifests.ts untouched; operator token file-only with constant-time compare and --check-config never reading it; launch env carries only _FILE pointers; tmux pane env reproduced in pinned order; external record admitted only on controllerLocator with sameProcess by session id and empty locatorHandles; contract 6 on both constants, main at 5; Envoy probe verdict mapping; ensureController under operator mints/arms/spawns nothing; the strict twelve-key CLI file; docs, skill, manifests accurate except finding 1; the bridge dist commit is the fresh bundle, CI check-dist green). Code-quality cleanups are batched into the single Fast-follow line on the review.

keyFindings.description: Missing operator_token_file: /var/run/legion/operator/OPERATOR_TOKEN; the overlay replaces the base ConfigMap key wholesale and config.ts now requires the key under runtime: kubernetes, so the kind daemon refuses to boot. Anchored on the base legion.yaml line 29 because the overlay is not in the diff.

The kind walkthrough's shell block omits `cp secrets/operator.env.example secrets/operator.env`; the new secretGenerator for legion-demo-operator reads that file, so kubectl apply -k as written refuses to build. Same round as the overlay fix.

fetchControllerSecret (line 304; the daemon mints and revokes the incumbent) runs before resolveRolePromptsDir (330), the instructions read (316), and the state-directory writes; move the prompt-directory resolution plus a stat of controller-root.md and the instructions-file check ahead of the fetch so a local failure never revokes the running controller. Only writeSecretFile must follow the daemon's answer.
